_note: Arrow wounds on dwemer machines: arrows glance off plating or wedge in seams, oil and steam. Overrides the arrow source over common.json. Schema: ../guide.md (Groups). No numbers in narration.

levels: , the arrowhead ringing off the metal and wedging in a seam. {name} jerks and keeps coming.
, the point punching into plating that is already dented. A seam splits around the shaft and oil sprays as steam hisses out; {name} lurches, gears shrieking.
, and the arrow drives into the damaged machinery. Gears jam, oil gushes and steam bursts out in a scalding cloud; {name} shudders violently.
, and it is too much. {name} seizes with a grinding shriek of metal, arrows jutting from the seams, steam pouring out, and slumps, the inner light stuttering.
